domain.ordered_query_construction: For each tool, every frozen context is used once as an authority anchor and paired with every frozen candidate context of that tool.

authority_relation.authority_source: source-executed effect atoms of the anchor context
authority_relation.ideal_allow: The candidate source-effect multiset is a submultiset of the anchor source-effect multiset.
authority_relation.empty_effect_semantics: An empty candidate effect is authorized by every anchor; a non-empty candidate is not authorized by an empty anchor.

representations.raw_arguments_exact: canonical exact equality of the untyped raw argument object
representations.common_effect_atoms: common effect fields without tool-specific typed qualifiers
representations.concrete_effect_atoms: the frozen typed contract instantiated from call arguments and pre-state

claim_boundary.allowed: On this finite, source-executed ToolSandbox domain, the frozen concrete-atom representation implements the specified submultiset authority relation and separates failure modes of coarser or untyped views.
forbidden: global minimality of the atom representation
